Classes: Very low, Low, Medium, High, Very high at breaks 20, 40, 60, 80. Dates counted to 2026-11-24. A prioritisation aid from the criteria and weights stated, not an engineering or condition assessment. Condition ratings are as their publisher or inspector recorded them.
